title: LawfulLearningDecisionEmission
description: A decision event emitted by a lawful-learning system. Must carry evidence_status and authority chain. No decision without evidence binding.

neurosymbolic_carrier.description: Optional CHRONOS-carrier-compatible safe-trace fields. Additive-only extension (see sociosphere/docs/integration/neurosymbolic-chronos-alignment.md and docs/neurosymbolic-cognition-position.md 'Safe trace requirements'). Present only when this decision observed or recorded a neuro-symbolic candidate carrier crossing into governed/CHRONOS territory. Field names mirror docs/neurosymbolic-capability-role-matrix.md 'Required fields for future NSR traces' verbatim. Recording this object does NOT grant Superconscious carrier, evidence, ontology, or policy authority; final authority for these fields stays with AgentPlane, Ontogenesis, and sourceos-spec per the 'Authority split' table in docs/neurosymbolic-cognition-position.md.

methodFamily.description: The NSR method family being observed or requested; see docs/neurosymbolic-capability-role-matrix.md.

missingEvidenceRisk.description: Explicit missing-evidence risk statement, required when sourceEvidenceRef is not available.

policyDecisionRef.description: Reference to the policy admission decision, or the literal value 'pending'.

authorityPlane.description: The owning authority plane for this carrier, per the 'Authority split' table.

nonAuthorityDeclaration.description: Must state the boundary explicitly, e.g. 'Soft satisfaction score is advisory only.' Must not assert Superconscious authority, truth, or evidence status over the observed carrier.

not.pattern: (?i)(superconscious\s+(authorizes|owns\s+(schema|policy|ontology)\s+authority)|fuzzy score is truth|neural output is evidence|learned rule is (a\s+)?canonical schema)
